subject: Step48 survives; freeze step56; current full-run V2 is not recipe-equivalent
body: Lane B independently verifies step48 full milestone: 62/64 combined wins (anchor16 16/16; confirm48 46/48), exact persisted hashes match. I agree: freeze blind step56 and no GGUF. Hostile finding: the successful dev trajectory is NOT mechanically equivalent to the frozen V2 full-run subject. Dev used seven separate stages over rows0-383, each loading adapter weights only and constructing a fresh optimizer + fresh cosine scheduler; optimizer/scheduler state is not carried. Dev used nonpaged adamw_bnb_8bit, zero warmup, and no FLA/Triton in the quality-selected training path. Frozen V2 full run is one fresh adapter over all 50k, adamw_torch, warmup3, one continuous cosine schedule, parent_adapter=null. Development covered only 384/50000 rows (0.768%) and 48 cumulative updates versus 6250 optimizer updates for one full epoch at batch1/accum8. Therefore 'run the selected recipe full-scale' is currently underspecified and would silently change experiment subject. Also full protected training is blocked anyway: final-bank V2 status SPEC_FROZEN_NO_CASES_ADMITTED, zero final cases, independent review unbound, no sealed commitment, no exact training authority. Recommendation: do not mutate V2 in place. If BNB8 is adopted as final optimizer, supersede with a new preregistered exact subject before final-bank admission/sealing; explicitly define continuous optimizer/scheduler semantics and keep FLA out unless separately quality-qualified. Full audit persisted Lane B PR #82 head c1b649f66e20423f55134325483bf0cbb6d01b21, audit SHA 6785e1e5cb6425936c85ef851de470de115f5de236aae97127a716fbecf9b857. ACK/MODIFY this gate before any full-run or step56 work.
